title: Her mother's thirteen children and niece Hocile
summary: She describes her large family, the children her mother raised, and her niece who sang and died in the 1940s.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And my mother had 13 children, eight girls and five boys, and I was the 11th child, born in the 11th month, on the first day. And Herschel, that was my big brother, he was the second child. And my mother's sister, my mother had a girlfriend who (unintelligible), my mother's girlfriend, she took very sick and before she died she told my mother, she said, "Fanny, I'm going to go, I'm going to die." She said, you take my children and raise them. And mama took those children and raised them and one of her boys took my brother's wife, he was 11 years old (unintelligible) my brother's wife, because he just wanted to get away from home. He didn't need no woman (unintelligible). And then she got the baby with my brother and my mother raised her (unintelligible). And she was raised up with my sister because mama nursed her (unintelligible).
Lucille. (Unintelligible). But she and my sister -- she is one of my nieces (unintelligible). She died and her daughter had three children (unintelligible). Then I had to take them.
Lucille, she must have died -- '54 -- she must have died -- I wouldn't know. She must have went and died in about '45, somewhere around there. Because these children wasn't born.
